facts.fact: Al-Youm Al-Sabaa reports that MP Engy Anwar, deputy head of the House's culture and media committee, tabled a bill amending Articles 25 and 26 of cybercrime law 175/2018 and adding Article 26 bis to punish AI deepfakes and AI-made content violating privacy, with up to 5 years and EGP 3 million for AI defamation and a fine of twice the profit for fake AI endorsements.
facts.system: Bill amending Law 175 of 2018 on deepfakes

EGY.note: Document is about a criminal-law bill; no government use of AI stated.
No local AI model, dataset or computing stated.
Consumer protection is mentioned only against fabricated advertising, not digital financial services.

facts.fact: Al-Youm Al-Sabaa describes the existing information technology crimes law No. 175 of 2018, with penalties in Articles 25 and 26, as the current law that the tabled amendment bill would change.
facts.system: Law 175 of 2018 on combating information technology crimes
